text:
ada: Poked a doc PR to unify error mapping for 429s/timeouts/context limits across the troubleshooting guide and the migrate-from-legacy-models doc. Mostly link fixes + one small example for graceful fallback. Can folks skim?

michael: Will take a look. Can you include a tiny example that shows mapping server 429 -> client Retry-After parse and fallback to a lower-cost model? Support wants that pattern surfaced.

ada: Threw in a short pseudo-flow: detect 429, read `Retry-After` (seconds or float), back off with expo+jitter, then if still failing after N attempts, route to `model:fast-alpha` (lower context) and return degraded output with a `warning` field. Kept it non-prod.

jo: Nice. Please add 2 lines on handling context-limit errors (409-like or a custom `context_exceeded` body). Recommend trimming conversation history by last-N tokens and include a sample `ctx-trim` CLI command.

ad a: (typo) Updated to add `ctx-trimmer` example: `ctx-trimmer --input convo.json --max-tokens 2048 --strategy=drop-oldest` and a note to test on staging.

michael: Also suggest we standardize header names in the runbook: `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`, and `X-RateLimit-Policy`. Call out that some infra uses `retry-after-ms` — advise tolerating both.

ci-bot: Running link sanity on branch docs/errormap-unify. Scanning... found 4 issues:
- /legacy/errors/429-handling -> 410 (deprecated page)
- /tools/old-ctx-trimmer -> 404
- /sdk/py/retries -> 404
- /runbooks/fallbacks#alpha -> anchor missing

adam: I pushed updates: redirect rule for the legacy errors page, updated the ctx-trimmer CLI path to `/tools/ctx-trimmer`, fixed the SDK link to `/sdk/python/retries`, and removed the broken anchor (added a small section instead).

jo: Editorial nit: the fallback example uses the word "degraded" twice in adjacent bullets. Could we rephrase to "fallback output" then "grace note"?

adam: Reworded. Also added a short warning: do not run ctx-trimmer against production conversation logs; use a copy in staging.

marco: Quick security check: ensure the examples use obviously fake tokens and the staging domain `docs-staging.redwood.ai`. Also add a short line about scrubbing PII before running local repros.

adam: Done — fake tokens and staging host added, PII scrub note included.

devops-bot: Staging docs deploy queued for 2026-04-05 05:00 UTC. Preview generated; snippet rendering looks OK except for one fenced block flagged for MD lint (line length).

adam: Trimmed the long inline JSON in the snippet to a compact one-liner. Ready to merge after CI passes. Thanks all!
